description: This file defines the BankingService interface, which declares methods related to banking operations such as managing customers, accounts, and transactions within the application.

classes.name: BankingService
classes.description: Interface declaring banking-related operations such as customer management, account management, and transaction retrieval.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all customers' details.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer with the provided customer details, returns an HTTP response entity.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds and returns customer details based on the customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer details for a given customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes the customer identified by the customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves account information for the given account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a customer based on account information and customer number.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs a transfer operation using the provided transfer details for a specified customer.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transaction details associated with the specified account number.
